name: Handa Mayuka
source:
Loves her younger sister Sasa dearly. Masayuki’s wife. 
Still thinks of Sasa as the child she used to live with. 
Adores her little sister, who relies on her because of the age gap between them. 

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=138]MangaGamer[/url]]
